subject.title: perf(sessions): reuse parsed transcripts for successor rotation

question: Should successor rotation adopt the existing bounded SessionManager parsed-entry cache despite the measured retained-memory cost and added session-state coupling?
rationale: The review found no actionable correctness defect, but this is an intentional runtime ownership tradeoff affecting the source used to write persisted successor transcripts.

options.title: Accept bounded cache reuse
options.body: Merge after refreshing the branch, keeping the metadata validation, cache caps, differential tests, and canonical cold fallback.

options.title: Keep rotation independent
options.body: Decline or pause the optimization if successor rotation should not depend on process-local SessionManager state.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded cache reuse
recommendation.body: Merge after refreshing the branch, keeping the metadata validation, cache caps, differential tests, and canonical cold fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest direct history signal is the prior session-cache hardening commit whose invariant this PR extends.
